UM-89.name: Kingman Reef, United States Minor Outlying Islands

notes.AF: Correct swapped Paktia/Paktika codes and split Parwan/Panjshir and Uruzgan/Daykundi using source GeoNames labels.
notes.AZ: Correct Lachin mislabeled as Lankaran, separate district/city features and merge Nakhchivan districts.
notes.BA: Merge Federation cantons and Republika Srpska districts; Posavina belongs to the Federation. Brcko remains excluded pending eBird treatment.
notes.BD: Merge Rangpur back into the historical Rajshahi division used by eBird.
notes.BS: Merge source districts to the combined island groups named by eBird.
notes.CN: Explicit numeric-to-alphabetic province rekey; exclude unassigned/disputed island fragments.
notes.FI: Merge Aland municipalities into FI-01; do not treat AX as a separate eBird country.
notes.HR: Use the secondary English name to correct duplicated HR-12 (Pozega-Slavonia).
notes.IE: Merge counties into the four historical provinces; IE-U includes only the Republic's Ulster counties.
notes.KR: Correct Jeju/Sejong code collision and Gangwon rekey.
notes.KZ: Separate Almaty province from Almaty city despite their duplicated source ISO code.
notes.LV: Separate five districts from cities despite duplicated source codes, and correct swapped Sala/Salacgriva.
notes.MK: Rekey municipalities and merge Drugovo, Oslomej, Vranestica and Zajas into Kicevo; source Skopje feature is Petrovec per GeoNames/FIPS.
notes.PR: Use Natural Earth admin-2 municipios with explicit reviewed source feature IDs.
notes.RS: Merge seven Vojvodina districts; Rasina source code/name requires review.
notes.TZ: Replace the complete regional scheme with the 2019 NBS/geoBoundaries layer, including Mbeya/Songwe; explicit names avoid ISO code collisions. Nightly input is vendored with checksum.
notes.VN: Merge the 63 source provinces into the 34 units used by eBird following the 2025 government reorganization.
notes.KI: Assign the pinned source polygon components to Gilbert, Line and Phoenix island groups. No bounding rectangles are drawn.
notes.SC: Separate Aldabra polygon components from the other Outer Islands. Perseverance is absent from the source.
notes.KY: Assign the two separate sister-island polygons; Grand Cayman district boundaries remain unresolved.
notes.IN: Separate the three disconnected source parts into Daman/Diu and Dadra/Nagar Haveli; retain actual land outlines.
notes.MV: Separate Male from the incorrectly duplicated Meemu code; retain Alif Alif and Alif Dhaal as separate eBird codes.
notes.PH: Use the 2020 province layer, merge NCR districts and reunite Isabela City with Basilan and Cotabato City with Maguindanao.
notes.SI: Replace the source Kostel/Osilnica and Cankova/Tisina combined outlines with four OSM municipality polygons; merge Apace back into historical Gornja Radgona.

deferred.DK: eBird uses 13 regions; the source uses five. Resolve the historical/custom geography before matching.
deferred.LY: eBird uses 34 historical districts; available source layers use 22 modern districts. Do not substitute one for the other.
deferred.QA: eBird uses nine historical municipalities; available source layers use a different seven/eight-municipality scheme.
deferred.MU: Cargados Carajos Shoals are absent from the prepared land geometry.
deferred.SC: Perseverance is reclaimed land absent from the older source; a newer outline is needed.
deferred.UM: Kingman Reef has no source land polygon; do not invent a rectangle for a reef.
